context.title: C4 context: actors and external trust
context.caption: CityPulse supports investigation by human actors. The identity provider and data source are separate trust boundaries. Source licensing and completeness are not established by authentication. Chain operations attest a content digest rather than establish measurement truth. The diagram does not assert a real identity-provider enrollment, licensed live feed, municipal partner or public-chain deployment.

containers.title: C4 containers: implemented runtime boundaries
containers.caption: Next mediates browser requests and Spring owns canonical authorization/persistence. Python isolates numerical libraries and uses trusted service tenant context. An explicitly enabled local synthetic/manual adapter is a narrower exception, not tenant retrieval or audited persistence. Blockchain submission is operator-driven in the local demonstration; no background attestation worker is implied.

components.title: C4 components: modular API
components.caption: This view shows components within the modular Java boundary rather than independent business microservices. Permission checks are not delegated to UI visibility or model instructions. Repository ports, transactional services and scoped adapters keep business logic separate from controllers. Database owners remain administratively powerful even when runtime audit mutation is revoked.

sequence.title: Sequence: authorized persisted decision
sequence.caption: The numbered sequence makes the trust transitions explicit. A local unsaved scenario omits Java persistence and cannot be presented as an audited tenant result. Retried writes use scoped idempotency receipts. Solver infeasibility or unavailable upstream services are not replaced with sample plans. Export and reproduction refer to evaluated canonical inputs, not subsequent form edits.

erd.title: ERD: principal logical relationships
erd.caption: The physical appendix is definitive for column declarations and composite constraints. City is assigned through tenant_city rather than falsely shown as directly tenant-owned. Business/source/observation and inventory references include tenant protection. Chat and decision objects narrow access by subject ownership. This overview omits some foreign keys for readability and is not a full database introspection.

ingestion.title: Data ingestion and publication lifecycle
ingestion.caption: Local normalization and remote publication have different success boundaries. A written checkpoint is not evidence that every API write arrived. Repeated publication relies on scoped server receipts. Quality is a rule-based diagnostic, not source truth or model confidence. Explicit modes and compatible time/unit/geographic definitions must survive each transformation.

ml.title: ML lifecycle: chronological segmented evaluation
nodes: Latency and drift; no auto claim
ml.caption: Each segment is separate; the experiment does not establish unseen-city transfer. Rolling one-step tests use earlier observed targets at later origins. Validation selects the model and also supplies residual intervals, so interval coverage is diagnostic rather than an independent conformal guarantee. Recursive horizon widening requires separate evaluation.

blockchain.title: Blockchain proof verification
blockchain.caption: Attestation IDs include chain ID, registry address, submitter and event ID. The local sample reports a matched original digest and a failed tampered comparison. A DIGEST_RECORDED database row is not CHAIN_CONFIRMED until receipt checks succeed. Reorg/finality, signer custody, source quality and deletion limits remain operational responsibilities.

pulseai.title: PulseAI: evidence selection, not generated claims
pulseai.caption: Retrieved text is untrusted and cannot select arbitrary SQL or tools. Both Python and Java validate provider-selected IDs, while factual prose and citations are constructed from permitted evidence. Missing data remains unknown. The model does not infer protected tenant filters from natural-language instructions or autonomously change dashboards.

trust.title: Security data flow and trust boundaries
trust.caption: The layers do not trust browser roles or model instructions as authority. JWT validation, current membership and tenant/owner predicates are independent. Explicit Bearer API requests are exempt from CSRF, while cookie-only/non-API mutations retain protection. TLS, Redis ACLs, IdP setup, edge quotas and real MFA enrollment still require deployment evidence.

deployment.title: Deployment: local verification and AWS code
deployment.caption: Linux CI validates Compose, while local Docker Desktop was unavailable. AWS modules are provider-schema and mocked-plan validated, not applied. Counts default to zero pending roles, migration and identity bootstrap; data/network resources would still incur costs after an apply. Internal HTTP, NAT egress and writable ephemeral cloud roots are documented follow-up gaps.

monitoring.title: Observability and operational evidence
monitoring.caption: Compose smoke confirms real scrape targets and actual stored spans; this is stronger than container process health alone. Request logs exclude raw query/body/token fields. Local alert rules are not a tested pager route, and proposed SLOs are not achieved service levels. CloudWatch is an ECS log configuration path, not an asserted deployed centralized logging service.
